title: Inside the largest gathering of unionized tradeswomen in the world, talk of tariffs
summary: Women make up only 4 percent of construction workers on job sites working with tools. Some are worried that tariffs on building supplies will slow down commercial building construction.

title: Jaguar Land Rover Shutdown Worsens UK Factory Slump, PMI Shows
